turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for getting in touch. Orders without custom or pre-order items are typically fulfilled within 2–3 business days. Once your order ships, you’ll receive a tracking link by email or SMS, depending on your preference. Tracking can take up to 3 additional business days to update after shipment, excluding weekends and holidays.

Pre-order items typically ship within 4–6 weeks, and custom items can take longer. Promotional periods and holidays may also extend processing times 📦

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once your order ships, delivery typically takes:

Domestic Priority Shipping: 2–7 business days from the shipment date
U.S. Express Delivery: 1–2 business days from the shipment date
International delivery: 15–20 business days

These timeframes exclude processing time and aren’t guaranteed. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time 📦

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
If your order has shipped, please allow up to 3 business days for tracking to update, excluding weekends and holidays. Custom items, pre-orders, and phone cases can take longer.

If there’s still no update after that, send your order number, checkout email, and phone number so I can check the shipment for you 📦

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out. A long delay does not automatically qualify for compensation. If the shipment is confirmed as stalled or lost, the available resolution depends on the tracking status, shipping protection, destination, order history, and item availability.

To check your order specifically, please send your order number, the email used at checkout, or the phone number on the order 📦
